approach.summary: Forward raw webhook values through the injected Transformer with observer ordering and unchanged results.
rules: Delegate raw input exactly once; never trim, uppercase, coerce, retry, recover panics, or replace values.
Call Started before Transform for a non-nil observer; call Finished only when Transform returns no error.
Return original result and original error unchanged.

title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
